title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
summary: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.

title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
summary: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday’s inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
summary: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
summary: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
summary: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

title: Strategy Buys $82M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $188M of STRC
summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm sold $284 million of MSTR stock to fund the moves, days before MSCI names companies facing index removal.

title: Coinbase Joins Circle, Ripple With Final OCC Approval for Federal Trust Bank Charter
summary: The exchange will move its institutional crypto custody business under federal oversight, building on its 2018 New York trust charter.

title: Trump Says He Knows 'Nothing' About World Liberty Financial as He Defends UAE Ties
summary: Pressed on why he doesn't divest from the family's crypto venture, Trump said his sons run the business and every president faces conflicts.

title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
summary: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.

title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
summary: FinCEN’s order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
summary: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
summary: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Peña.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
summary: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.

title: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group
summary: OFAC targeted offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives hide assets and dodge earlier sanctions.

title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data
summary: Gnosis Pay said hackers accessed customer information on the legacy system behind its branded cards, though funds weren’t affected and its enterprise card platform was untouched.

title: Crypto Liquidations Top $1 Billion as Bitcoin Tests 11-Week Low
summary: Bitcoin fell toward $75,500 after AI stocks plunged, and over $1 billion in the crypto derivatives market has been wiped out.

title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
summary: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn't moved.
